name: TikTok Series / Playlists
strategic_objective: Episodic learning or storytelling that encourages binge-watching and recurring viewing.

tone: Consistent, educational, and focused. Still delivered with TikTok’s direct, fast style.
copywriting_rules: Each episode should clearly reference where it fits in the series (for example part 1, part 2). The caption should be consistent across episodes in structure and mention the series name or tag. Encourage viewers to watch previous or next parts.
Line 1: series name or part indicator. Line 2: what this specific episode covers. Final line: CTA to watch other parts or follow the series.
Series hashtag acts as a unifier; topical hashtags still support discovery.
Tag collaborators or recurring guests if the series includes them.

required_generation_elements: CTA pointing to other episodes or future parts
hard_constraints: Random, unconnected videos labeled as a series
Episodes that cover too many topics at once
No guidance on where to start or what to watch next
